notes: This is an alphabetic poem in Hebrew. The pinned text moves from the mem line in verse 13 to the samekh line in verse 14; it has no separate nun line. The translation does not supply one.
Verse 6 follows the read form, “your greatness,” rather than the written plural. Verse 12 changes from addressing God to speaking of “his” deeds and kingdom; that shift is retained.
vocabulary: God’s rule is pictured as a kingship lasting through every generation.
